test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.

After she will get her degree, she moved to Germany.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is describing an action ("**she moved to Germany**") that took place in the past, following another action ("**she will get her degree**").
 
• The segment "**After she will get her degree**" is incorrect because "**will get**" is future tense, which doesn't match the past tense action "**she moved**".
 
• The correct form should be "**After she got her degree**" to maintain tense consistency.
 
• Thus, the underlined segment needs to be substituted with **Option 1**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"After she got her degree, she moved to Germany."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "After she got her degree"** – This option is correct because it uses the past tense to match the action that follows, "she moved".
 
• **2: "After she get her degree"** – This option is incorrect because "get" is not the correct tense.
 
• **3: "After she gets her degree"** – This option is incorrect because "gets" is present tense and does not match the past tense "moved".
